idea.title: The face and its untrustworthy echo — different tempos
idea.premise: 2 transparent convex masks share the same visual space. Motion: amber smile at 1 relative turns, electric_blue neutral at 2 relative turns.
idea.viewer_experience: Follow one expression as the masks overlap; the near/far interpretation may change.

illusion.cue_withheld: Front/back occlusion, shading differences and perspective size cues
illusion.question: Can you keep the same face in front throughout the loop?
illusion.observable_event: Distinct facial contours overlap, separate into profiles, and return.

idea.authorship_note: Reference-inspired procedural concept; uniqueness is not externally verified.
